sn18.11:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn18.11:1.3: atha kho āyasmā rāhulo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ rāhulaṃ bhagavā eta davoca
sn18.11:1.7: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti.
sn18.11:1.9: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu taṃ samanu passituṃ
sn18.11:1.10: etaṃ mama esohamasmi eso me attāti.
sn18.11:1.18: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti.
sn18.11:1.20: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ
sn18.11:1.21: etaṃ mama esohamasmi eso me attāti.
sn18.11:1.23: evaṃ passaṃ rāhula sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmimpi nibbindati sotasmimpi nibbindati ghānasmimpi nibbindati jivhāyapi nibbindati kāyasmimpi nibbindati manasmimpi nibbindati
sn18.11:1.24: nibbindaṃ virajjati virāgā vimuccati. vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
sn18.11:1.25: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti.
